g.title: lineage
g.text: Google Ads + Merchant Center [Advertising and product data]
This map shows how source data enters the Microsoft Fabric model at Bronze, is shaped through Silver and Intermediate, consolidated in Gold, and exposed through the Semantic layer.
Each node is a warehouse table or view. Arrows point from an object to its upstream dependencies, so read the diagram right to left.
Example layer path: read right to left
